in_sanskrit.name: हीमप्रिया
in_sanskrit.meaning:
हीम (Hima) - Snow
प्रिय (Priya) - Dear

Therefore, HimaPriya means 'Snow-dear' or 'Snow-beloved'
in_sanskrit.long_meaning:
हेम्ना (Hemna) - Snow
प्रिय (Priya) - Dear

Therefore, HimaPriya means 'Dear Snow' or 'Beloved Snow' or 'Snow-goddess'

Himapriyaa's name is derived from 'Hima' which means snow and 'Priyaa' which means dear or beloved.

Himapriyaa is also the name of a Hindu goddess who is the consort of the god Himavat. Himapriyaa was believed to be the goddess of snow and the mother of the Himalayas. She is mentioned in various Hindu texts, including the Mahabharata, the Puranas, and the Atharvaveda.
